Despite this, an incident pushes Shun back into the world of online gaming. In order to repay the money they owe, Shun reluctantly agrees to participate in an online game tournament: Xaxerion Championship. Joined by their classmate Akito Sendou, the three of them scout for talented players to rebuild the team.
